name: konami_code
description: Executes the secret Konami Code sequence in Block Garden to unlock dev mode, ore depth scanner, fast growth, and hidden options.

autoExecute.description: Whether to automatically trigger the key sequence in the active game viewport (default: true).

execution.code:
const requestId = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2); const cmd = typeof BroadcastChannel !== 'undefined' ? new BroadcastChannel('block-garden-commands') : null; const res = typeof BroadcastChannel !== 'undefined' ? new BroadcastChannel('block-garden-results') : null; if (!cmd || !res) { return '⚠️ Live 3D World Not Connected: BroadcastChannel is unavailable in this environment.'; } const result = await new Promise((resolve) => { const t = setTimeout(() => { res.close(); resolve('⚠️ Live 3D World Not Connected:
The "konami_code" tool transmits the secret cheat code to an active <block-garden> game instance, but no live game was detected in this session.

To enable the live 3D world in ShadowClaw:
1. Allowlist <block-garden> and its scripts in shadow-claw.config.json under "customElements":
   • allowedElements: ["block-garden", "block-garden-option", "block-garden-select"]
   • scripts: adapter ({ "src": "...", "hasInit": true }) and bundle
2. Pin a page in view (e.g., in Pages or Split View) containing:
   <block-garden id="live-block-garden" data-no-nav></block-garden>
   (Keeping the page pinned keeps the 3D world active while you chat or execute commands. Do not add inline <script> tags).

Instructions for the Agent:
Explain to the user that the Konami cheat code requires an active Block Garden instance in ShadowClaw. Remind the user to ensure <block-garden> and its scripts are configured in shadow-claw.config.json and that a page containing <block-garden id="live-block-garden" data-no-nav></block-garden> is pinned in view while running the tool.'); }, 350); res.onmessage = (e) => { if (e.data && e.data.requestId === requestId) { clearTimeout(t); res.close(); resolve(e.data.result); } }; cmd.postMessage({ type: 'blockgarden:konamicode', requestId }); cmd.close(); }); return result;
